scope.task: 把 STM32 PA1 的完整周期调到 1000 ms，误差不超过 50 ms。

descriptor.effects: Read selected physical observations; no firmware changes. UART capture resets its RX FIFO to exclude stale bytes before reading.

commands:
set -eu
BB=/bin/busybox
test -x "$BB" || exit 72
[ "$((4294967295))" = "4294967295" ] || exit 72
test -r /sys/class/xdevcfg/xdevcfg/device/prog_done || exit 73
[ "$("$BB" cat /sys/class/xdevcfg/xdevcfg/device/prog_done)" = "1" ] || exit 73
test -r /sd/pl/zhidiao_observe_v5_led.bit || exit 73
image_sha=$("$BB" sha256sum < /sd/pl/zhidiao_observe_v5_led.bit) || exit 73
[ "$image_sha" = 'fb4d05e6a075bd405ffa14c1d1a6631fa0a42e4833999c0a0f24b92b027118d6  -' ] || exit 73
CLOCK=/proc/uptime
clock_ms() {
    read up rest < "$CLOCK" || exit 72
    case "$up" in *.*) seconds=${up%%.*}; fraction=${up#*.} ;; *) exit 74 ;; esac
    case "$seconds:$fraction" in *[!0123456789:]*|:*|*:) exit 74 ;; esac
    [ "${#seconds}" -le 12 ] && [ "${#fraction}" -le 9 ] || exit 74
    case "$seconds" in 0) ;; 0*) exit 74 ;; esac
    fraction=${fraction}000
    fraction=${fraction%${fraction#???}}
    printf '%u' "$((seconds * 1000 + 1$fraction - 1000))"
}
read_reg() {
    raw=$("$BB" devmem "$1" 32) || exit 72
    case "$raw" in 0x*) digits=${raw#0x} ;; *) exit 74 ;; esac
    case "$digits" in ''|*[!0123456789abcdefABCDEF]*) exit 74 ;; esac
    [ "${#digits}" -le 8 ] || exit 74
    printf '%u' "$((raw))"
}

"$BB" usleep 0 || exit 72
started=$(clock_ms) || exit $?
deadline=$((started + 15000))
edge_start=$(read_reg 0x43C40000) || exit $?
i=0
while [ "$i" -lt 300 ]; do
    now=$(clock_ms) || exit $?
    [ "$now" -ge "$started" ] || exit 74
    [ "$now" -lt "$deadline" ] || exit 75
    edge_before=$(read_reg 0x43C40000) || exit $?
    delta=$(( (edge_before - edge_start) & 4294967295 ))
    valid=$(read_reg 0x43C40008) || exit $?
    if [ "$delta" -ge 2 ] && [ "$delta" -lt 2147483648 ] && [ "$valid" -eq 1 ]; then
        period=$(read_reg 0x43C30000) || exit $?
        high=$(read_reg 0x43C30008) || exit $?
        valid_after=$(read_reg 0x43C40008) || exit $?
        edge_after=$(read_reg 0x43C40000) || exit $?
        if [ "$edge_before" -eq "$edge_after" ] && [ "$valid_after" -eq 1 ]; then
            now=$(clock_ms) || exit $?
            [ "$now" -lt "$deadline" ] || exit 75
            printf 'ZHIDIAO_PL_V1 %u %u %u %u %u %u\n' "$edge_start" "$edge_before" "$edge_after" "$valid_after" "$period" "$high"
            exit 0
        fi
    fi
    i=$((i + 1))
    if [ "$i" -lt 300 ]; then "$BB" usleep 50000 || exit 72; fi
done
exit 75
period.effects: Read-only PL readiness and fresh period/high register observation over SSH; no bitstream loading.
period.image_identity: Deployment must prepare the configured observation image; prog_done and SD file hash do not identify the running image.

    case "$digits" in ''|*[!0123456789abcdefABCDEF]*) exit 74 ;; esac
    [ "${#digits}" -le 8 ] || exit 74

# Read old sticky health flags before clearing the old RX session.
read_reg 0x43C50008 > /dev/null || exit $?
"$BB" devmem 0x43C5000C 32 0x00000002 > /dev/null || exit 72
started=$(clock_ms) || exit $?
deadline=$((started + 5000))
count=0
overflow=0
frame=0
parity=0
limited=0
iterations=0
printf 'ZHIDIAO_UART_V1\n'
while [ "$iterations" -lt 1526 ]; do
    iterations=$((iterations + 1))
    now=$(clock_ms) || exit $?

    [ "$((status & 64))" -eq 0 ] || frame=1
    [ "$((status & 128))" -eq 0 ] || parity=1

model_decision.reason: 真实 PL 测得 PA1 完整周期为 601.7169 ms，高电平为 300.36864 ms，且当前循环每次翻转后 HAL_Delay(300)，因此一个完整周期包含两次约 300 ms 延时。将单次延时改为 500 ms，预计完整周期约 1000 ms，可满足 ±50 ms 目标。构建成功和烧录 verified 仅证明固件已成功生成并写入，不代表硬件周期通过；UART 的 partial_tail 仅表示采集结束时最后一行缺少换行，不是固件故障。修改后仍需由 PL 重新测量 PA1 判定。
